ruling.recommended_action: Issue a voucher of $2.40 to the rider for the unexempt detour mileage (1.70 km × $1.41/km); the $1.15 metered waiting charge stands as it corresponds to the rider-named stop at Clementi Mall. Record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat messages [F9][F10] and the driver's statement [F12] contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is fare/route, not safety. No SAFE-1/SAFE-2 trigger.

Evidence: GPS and timeline are complete and consistent (chat fully timestamped, F11); nothing needed is missing → sufficient.

The disputed segment. One off-route segment [F4] 14:21–14:31, 3.81 km driven vs 2.11 km optimal, +1.70 km, up to 554 m off route. It is bracketed by the stationary period [F2] 14:23–14:27 at (1.3149, 103.7641) — not a pickup/drop-off point, ~2.5 km from NUS. The rider's own message [F9] at 14:17, before the segment, named the place: "Can you stop at Clementi Mall? I need to grab a parcel" and the driver accepted [F10]. Under RD-3(a) a rider-named stop is exempt, and per RD-3's "do not split the stop from the way there" rule the whole segment driven to reach Clementi Mall is exempt — the +1.70 km detour is the way to the named stop, and the 4-minute halt at 14:23–14:27 matches the parcel stop. The detour is not a driver errand or unrouted choice: no traffic incident exists on the alternative [F15], the speed bands [F13][F14] are on other roads and under RD-4(b) do not exempt on their own, but they are irrelevant since no exemption is needed. So the segment is exempt and forms no unexempt detour → no RD-2 refund under the route-deviation branch.

The real overcharge. RydeTAXI bills by meter, so mileage and waiting units enter the fare directly (RD-2/RD-3(c)). Billed distance 10.39 km [F8] against GPS-measured travel of 10.4 km [F1]; distance fare $14.65 + time $4.16 + waiting $1.15. The rider-named stop is exempt, so the extra mileage to Clementi Mall is not refundable mileage, and the waiting charge of $1.15 [F6] (4.4 min × $0.26/min) is a metered waiting unit properly incurred at the rider's requested stop — RD-3(c) says waiting at a stop is charged and not refunded.

The discrepancy. The billing includes an "excess distance billed $2.76 (1.96 km × $1.41/km)" [F5] on top of the metered 10.39 km distance fare [F8], i.e. the rider is charged the metered distance AND a separate excess-distance line for essentially the same detour kilometres that the fare already captured; F5's 1.96 km also exceeds the 1.70 km actually extra [F4] and the 2.0 km total delta [F1]. That double-counted excess-distance charge [F5] is an unpublished/unfounded add-on for a RydeTAXI trip (RD-2/FARE-1): refund the portion not accounted for by the exempt detour, i.e. $2.76 − (1.70 km × $1.41 = $2.40) = $0.36, plus the double-charging effect. Refunding the whole excess-distance line $2.76 minus the $0.36 already represented in legitimately metered detour mileage gives a partial refund of the remaining unexplained $2.40 [F5][F4]. Rounding to the cent: 1.70 × 1.4100 = $2.3970 ≈ $2.40.

Amount: refund_partial $2.40.

Driver flag. RD-2 refund > 0 and driver profile shows 2 route disputes upheld in 90 d [F18], so RD-6 applies: the case adds to a "repeated" pattern → flag_account for Ryde account review. The profile fact is used only for this add-on action, not to establish the deviation itself.

segment_findings.reason: RD-3(a): the rider messaged at 14:17, before the 14:21–14:31 segment, naming the place — 'Can you stop at Clementi Mall? I need to grab a parcel, 3-4 minutes' [F9] — and the driver accepted [F10]; the car stopped there 14:23–14:27 [F2], matching the parcel stop. Under RD-3 the whole segment driven to reach the named place is exempt (the stop is not split from the way there), so the +1.70 km is not an unexempt detour. RD-4 provides no basis on its own here (no incident, F15; bands are on other roads, F13/F14) but no exemption is needed.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's premise that the whole detour was an unauthorised overcharge fails: the detour existed to reach a place the rider named before the segment [F9][F10], so it is exempt under RD-3(a) and no RD-2 mileage refund arises for it.
The $1.15 waiting charge [F6] is a metered waiting unit on a RydeTAXI trip incurred during the rider-requested stop; RD-3(c) keeps metered waiting at a stop chargeable, so it is not refunded.

The driver's implicit reliance on congestion is not made out: no traffic incident near the route [F15] and the speed bands [F13][F14] are on roads not matching the replaced optimal segment, so RD-4 gives no exemption.
